title: Restart policy after a manual stop
statement: A container was started with `--restart unless-stopped`. You run `docker stop` on it, and later the Docker daemon restarts (e.g. the host reboots). What happens to the container?
choices: It is started again when the daemon comes back
It stays stopped until someone starts it
It is started again only if its last exit code was non-zero
It is removed, because unless-stopped containers are not kept after a daemon restart
